chunks.text: Callie, Mia — come here, food's ready. Yes, the mac and cheese. Come get it before I eat all of it myself. Hurry up, I ain't calling y'all twice.
Merlin, bro, listen — tell Heaven don't cook nothing, I got the food handled tonight. And that bunker? Bro, when we're done with it, it's gonna be sick. Just watch.
